# GraphQL Schema Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > GraphQL

## Overview

Designs GraphQL schemas with types, queries, mutations, and subscriptions following schema design best practices

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [graphql-schema-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
graphql-schema-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@graphql-schema-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design schemas with scalar and object types
- Implement queries, mutations, and subscriptions
- Create input types and enums for parameters
- Design interfaces and union types for polymorphism

## Technology Standards Applied

- **GraphQL Spec**: Schema definition language specification
- **Schema Design**: Type design patterns and conventions
- **Naming Conventions**: GraphQL naming best practices
